race.description: It’s Tab Time Country Magic Showcase Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: Tough one to close. SWEET TREATS (9) returned from a four-month spell with a game win last start over 1300m at Orange, stalking the leading division then letting down a shade too well. Yet to fire in three previous second-up runs but she is more seasoned now and can get the job done again. DOUBTFREE (7) made it two on the trot when he comfortably took out a BM58 over 1300m at Corowa last time out. Just needs a bit of luck slotting in from a wide gate to be right in contention again. STAR EMPIRE (3) missed the kick and was never a factor behind DOUBTFREE at Corowa recently. Best form measures up favourably so he deserves another chance. LANG PARK (5) should go forward and give a good account on the back of sound recent performances. DIVINE SPARK (10) recorded his maiden win when returning from an eight-month spell over this distance at Wagga a fortnight ago. Consistent mare who looks to be in for her best campaign to date.
